fields.description: Subtotal of non-cash/profit adjustments in the operating cash-flow section before working-capital movements.
fields.hint: IFRS cash-flow statement: subtotal the adjustment rows after profit for the period and before working-capital movements. If no named subtotal is printed, sum only that adjustments block. Exclude working-capital movements, interest, taxes and investing/financing cash-flow lines.

aliases_en: Purchases of property, plant and equipment
Additions to properties, plant and equipment

aliases_ru: Поступления от выбытия основных средств и нематериальных активов
aliases_en: Proceeds from disposal of fixed assets
Proceeds from sale of intangible assets
fields.hint: Cash-flow statement, investing activities: cash proceeds from sale/disposal of non-current operating assets. If proceeds from sale of PPE and intangible assets are disclosed separately, sum the relevant rows; do not take only PPE when intangible proceeds are present.

Balance sheet, cash-flow statement or cash note. Extract every clearly disclosed date for cash and cash equivalents, not only balance-sheet dates; include comparative beginning/end balances when they are explicitly shown. Do not confuse with bank deposits/time deposits or marketable securities.

aliases_ru: Изменения в операционных активах и обязательствах
aliases_en: Changes in operating assets and liabilities
fields.description: Subtotal of working-capital movements inside operating cash flow.
fields.hint: IFRS cash-flow statement: subtotal the working-capital block, usually named changes in operating assets and liabilities / changes in working capital. If no subtotal is printed, sum only rows in that block. Exclude non-cash adjustments, interest, taxes and investing/financing cash flows.

aliases_ru: Амортизация основных средств и нематериальных активов
Износ и амортизация основных средств и нематериальных активов
fields.hint: ОДДС/примечания: если рядом раскрыты Depreciation and amortization и отдельная amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, общая D&A — их сумма. Не путай с ROU amortization.

fields.description: All cash dividends paid by the group during the period.
fields.hint: Cash-flow statement: all cash dividends paid during the period. If dividends paid to parent shareholders and non-controlling interests are disclosed separately, sum them. Parent-only dividends belong to DIVIDENDS_SHAREHOLDERS.

aliases_ru: уплаченные акционерам с неконтролирующими долями участия

aliases_en: Equity attributable to equity holders of the parent
Total shareholders' equity attributable to the parent
Equity attributable to owners of the Company

fields.description: Current income tax expense for the period, excluding deferred tax and one-off tax effects when separately disclosed.
fields.hint: IFRS P&L/tax note: take the current income tax expense line for the period. Do not replace it with the total income-tax benefit/expense line that combines current tax, deferred tax and one-off tax effects.

aliases_en: Profit attributable to equity holders of the parent
Net income attributable to shareholders of the parent
Profit for the year attributable to owners of the Company
Net income attributable to controlling interest

fields.hint: P&L: expenses after gross profit and before operating profit. If there is no single operating-expenses line, sum operating expense rows in that bridge: SG&A/administrative/selling expenses, D&A shown there, LTIP, ECL and similar operating expense rows. Exclude cost of sales, other operating income and finance/tax lines.
Balance sheet or lease/right-of-use asset note. Extract every clearly disclosed date, not only balance-sheet dates; include comparative closing balances from the lease note when explicitly shown.
P&L: first revenue line from ordinary activities. For segment-level SALES_REVENUE, prefer revenue/sales to external customers; do not include intersegment revenue when it is disclosed separately.
